newsitem.title: UK: NWE mogas surges $3-4 on US and tight local supply.
newsitem.headline: NWE mogas surges $3-4 on US and tight local supply.

text.p: NWE gasoline gained $3-4 a tonne on Wednesday as surging NYMEX prices pulled European numbers higher on the back of bullish stock data.
Tight supplies in NWE and the Mediterranean gave support to the push higher, dealers said.

Fresh supplies of material from August 15 onwards should ease the pressure and prices should slip back since the cargoes will have to head to the United States because local demand is not sufficient, dealers thought.
A 25-30,000 tonne Scandinavian eurograde cargo was offered at $208 fob NWE, but while most dealers accepted the Eurpoean market was strong, must said this level was overly optimistic.
"Around $202 fob would be reasonable given where swaps have been trading," said one.
August swaps traded up to $5.00 stronger at $205.00, $203.00, $204.00 and $204.50 while September found buyers at $193.50, $194.00 and $195.50.
